# Flow & Positioning Research Terminal

PM-facing research terminal for sector rotation, theme sponsorship, positioning pressure, crowding, reversal risk, validation, and daily market intelligence.

## Routes

- `/` - terminal overview
- `/rotation` - sector rotation board
- `/baskets` - theme basket monitor
- `/baskets/[slug]` - basket detail
- `/positioning` - options and short-interest proxy board
- `/crowding` - crowding and reversal monitor
- `/daily-note` - auditable PM daily note
- `/research/validation` - signal validation lab
- `/case-studies/korea-defense` - Korea / Indo-Pacific defense case study
- `/methodology` - proxy framework and data limitations

## Data Rules

No mock market data. Provider rows are live sourced data or frozen sourced snapshots selected with `DEMO_AS_OF_DATE`.

Every provider row stores point-in-time metadata: `asOfDate`, `observedAt`, `providerTimestamp`, `ingestedAt`, `source`, `provider`, `revisionFlag`, and `dataStatus`.
